description: This file defines a Java class 'MessageOnlyLogFilter' within the 'com.example.android.common.logger' package. The class implements the 'LogNode' interface and acts as a filter that only logs message content, stripping away other metadata. It supports chainable logging nodes by forwarding processed log messages to the next node in the chain.
